source: A.C.E Essential Website Build Questionnaire submission PDF

design_director.classification_method: complete-brief signal matching using locked A.C.E Design Director rules
signals: Customer experience goal: welcoming, relaxed, reassuring, never judged or rushed
Explicit rejection of clinical, overly glamorous, cluttered and corporate presentation
Preference for warm neutrals, soft cream and muted earthy tones
Sensitive/intimate service context where trust and personal reassurance matter
alternatives_considered: 03 Modern Minimal - supported by calm/understated and clean-layout preferences, but weaker than the owner-led, relationship-driven, warm/personal signals
05 Precision Professional - supported by professionalism/trust needs, but less aligned with the explicit preference for personal, relaxed, non-corporate presentation

image_decision.decision: image-light build using family-owned framing, soft surfaces and organic composition; no invented customer photography
image_decision.reason: Image Production Engine allows fewer images when assets are unavailable and requires website-design quality to remain high

architecture.reviews_module: omitted - customer supplied no genuine reviews
